specs.title: Group 1: Input formats support (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, TIFF, HEIC, Renamed)
Group 2: Output formats (JPG, PNG, WebP) and size guarantee ladder
Group 3: Photo 300x300 & 250x250 (centered, edge, tiny, closeup, rotated, tilted, dark, trans, 200x200)
Group 4: No face fallback and multiple faces handling
Group 5: Signature presets & ink extraction (300x80 & 250x50)
Group 6: Size cap enforcement (gov < 100KB, user lowered 30KB, tamper-proof)
Group 7: Custom size converter (px, cm, mm, inch@DPI) and saved presets
Group 8: Social presets & Fit modes (Cover, Contain, Stretch)
Group 9: Zero external requests & full offline capability
Group 10: Bilingual toggle (English/Bengali) & sub-path execution
T1: Crop rotation — frame rotates without source degradation
T2: Anti-ghosting — rotated images have clean background without duplicate underlay
T3: Localized numeric inputs — Bengali digit parsing and clamp verification
T4: Performance — proxy rAF preview does not block main UI thread
T5: Button responsiveness & 15s watchdog recovery
T6: Background removal sanity gate — handles skip gracefully
T7: Viewport responsiveness — no horizontal scrollbar overflow at 320/360/390/768/1440px
T8: mozjpeg baseline JFIF — output bytes do not contain SOF2 marker
T9: Lucide icons & zero FA / zero CC BY / zero emojis
T10: Full regression check — all functional pipelines pass
M-Test: Mobile layout (M0-M3) — letter-wrap detector, both panels visible, zero overflow
